title: Berlin businesswoman charged over alleged spying for Russia
summary: Prosecutors say the Berlin marketing executive used her political and military contacts to help a Russian intelligence officer gain access to influential circles and seek information on German…

image.caption: Prosecutors say the Russian intelligence officer whom Ilona W. allegedly assisted was based at the Russian Embassy in BerlinImage: Michael Bihlmayer/CHROMORANGE/picture alliance

blocks.text: German federal prosecutors have charged a 57-year-old Berlin businesswoman with carrying out intelligence activities for Russia.
Ilona W., who holds German and Ukrainian citizenship, is accused of working for the intelligence service of a foreign power, the Federal Prosecutor's Office said.
She was arrested on January 21 and remains in pre-trial detention.
This is a developing story that will be updated...
